dataset.review: Original authors' human relevance annotations; no new human review claimed.
dataset.split_policy: Original test labels frozen. Remove training queries whose positive documents occur in test; connected positive-document groups choose validation by SHA256 mod 5. Training negatives exclude all held-out documents.

candidate_pool: BM25 top 20; identical rankings for all rerankers
selection: Highest validation nDCG@10 across two BCE checkpoints and one explicit-hard-negative ranking checkpoint. Frozen before tuned test scoring.
promotion: Positive lower bound of paired evidence-cluster bootstrap 95% CI in test nDCG@10
